desc_en: This piece embodies relaxed sophistication for warm days. Crafted with a deliberate wrinkled texture, it offers a refined and lightweight visual presence. The short-sleeve design is completed with a functional chest pocket. Each garment is exclusively crafted to order for you. We offer worldwide shipping.

El diseño de manga corta se completa con un práctico bolsillo en el pecho. Cada prenda se confecciona exclusivamente bajo demanda para usted. Ofrecemos envíos a todo el mundo.
